plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate leveraged ETF risk and comply with the mandate.

conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5%/month return, prioritizing capital preservation. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, aiming for low drawdown. Expect lower growth potential but enhanced stability.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 2% to reduce leveraged ETF exposure while maintaining a small allocation.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5%/month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while blending broad index exposure with quality tech. Expect moderate drawdowns with reasonable growth potential.

plan: Add to SOXL and SPAL, increasing each to 6%, to lean into leveraged ETF exposure.

plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Add to QQQI, increasing its allocation to 30%, to boost income generation.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce broad index concentration and meet the mandate.

income.read: This income plan targets ~1%/month, aiming to park cash for yield. It rotates into income/covered-call ETFs and broad index, cutting high-beta names. Distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall; this is not a savings account but prioritizes low drawdown and reliable income.
